text: Yes, pretty much every day. I usually put something on while I'm commuting or doing housework, because it makes the time go faster. I'm not really a fan of silence, to be honest, so even when I'm studying I tend to have some quiet background music on.

tips.en: Frequency, situations and a reason — three details instead of a short “yes”.
tips.kk: Жиілік, жағдаяттар және себеп — қысқа «иәнің» орнына үш дерек.
tips.ru: Частота, ситуации и причина — три детали вместо короткого «да».
tips.example: while I'm commuting or doing housework

tips.en: Tend to is a natural way to talk about habits.
tips.kk: Tend to — әдеттер туралы айтудың табиғи тәсілі.
tips.ru: Tend to — естественный способ говорить о привычках.
tips.example: I tend to have some quiet background music on

note.en: A phrasal verb meaning “start playing music”.

questions.followUp: When do you listen to it most?
questions.question: Do you often listen to music?

text: I've got quite broad taste, but if I had to choose, I'd go for indie rock. I like the fact that the lyrics are often quite personal. That said, I've recently got into some Kazakh pop bands as well, mostly because my younger sister plays them all the time.

tips.en: If I had to choose, I’d go for politely narrows a broad answer down to one.
tips.kk: If I had to choose, I’d go for — кең жауапты сыпайы түрде біреуге дейін тарылтады.
tips.ru: If I had to choose, I’d go for — вежливо сужает широкий ответ до одного.
tips.example: if I had to choose, I'd go for indie rock

tips.en: That said adds an unexpected turn and a personal story.
tips.kk: That said күтпеген бұрылыс пен жеке оқиғаны қосады.
tips.ru: That said добавляет неожиданный поворот и личную историю.

title.en: A new detail with That said

tips.example: That said, I've recently got into some Kazakh pop bands

note.en: A ready phrase for questions about preferences.
note.kk: «Талғамым кең» — талғам туралы сұрақтарға дайын тіркес.
note.ru: «У меня широкий вкус» — готовая фраза для вопросов о предпочтениях.

note.en: A spoken phrasal verb: “started to like”.

questions.followUp: Why do you like that style?
questions.question: What kind of music do you like?

text: I did, actually. My parents sent me to piano lessons when I was about seven, and I kept going for around four years. I wasn't particularly talented, but it taught me to be patient. I sometimes regret giving it up, because I can barely play anything now.

tips.en: When, how long, what it taught — a mini story in the past tense.
tips.kk: Қашан, қанша уақыт, неге үйретті — өткен шақтағы шағын әңгіме.
tips.ru: Когда, сколько, чему научило — маленький рассказ в прошедшем времени.
tips.example: My parents sent me to piano lessons when I was about seven

tips.en: Regret + -ing is accurate grammar for feelings about the past.
tips.kk: Regret + -ing — өткенге қатысты сезімге дәл грамматика.
tips.ru: Regret + -ing — точная грамматика для чувств о прошлом.
tips.example: I sometimes regret giving it up

questions.question: Did you learn to play a musical instrument as a child?

text: It depends on the mood. On my own I like listening to something calm with headphones, since I can really focus on it. But with friends I much prefer live music — going to a concert is a completely different experience because of the energy of the crowd.

tips.en: It depends — then both options with reasons. It does not dodge the question.
tips.kk: It depends — және бірден екі нұсқа себептерімен. Жауап сұрақтан қашпайды.
tips.ru: It depends — и сразу оба варианта с причинами. Ответ не уходит от вопроса.
tips.example: On my own I like listening to something calm

tips.en: Since and because of are different ways to give a reason.
tips.kk: Since және because of — себепті білдірудің әртүрлі тәсілдері.
tips.ru: Since и because of — разные способы выразить причину.
tips.example: because of the energy of the crowd

note.en: A ready opening for “which do you prefer” questions.
A strong phrase instead of “very different”.

questions.followUp: Can you tell me about a concert you enjoyed?
questions.question: Do you prefer listening to music alone or with other people?

text: Not really, unfortunately. Most schools have music lessons in the first few years, but they're often seen as less important than maths or languages. Personally, I think that's a shame, because music can help children relax and express themselves.

tips.en: First how things are, then Personally, I think — fact and opinion are clearly separated.
tips.kk: Алдымен қалай екені, сосын Personally, I think — дерек пен пікір анық ажыратылады.
tips.ru: Сначала как есть, затем Personally, I think — видно, где факт, а где мнение.
tips.example: Personally, I think that's a shame

tips.en: Are often seen as — the passive sounds natural when the action matters more than who does it.
tips.kk: Are often seen as — кім емес, әрекет маңызды болғанда пассив табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: Are often seen as — пассив звучит естественно, когда важно действие, а не кто.
tips.example: they're often seen as less important than maths or languages

note.en: Shows the speaker’s attitude at once.

questions.question: Is music an important subject at school in your country?
